title: Frontend: Tic Tac Toe
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Tic Tac Toe. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Nine buttons[data-cell=0..8] alternate X/O. Occupied cells and terminal games ignore clicks. [data-testid=status] is Next: X/O, Winner: X/O, or Draw. Reset[data-action=reset] clears. Detect all rows, columns and diagonals.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Store the board and next player, then derive winner/draw from the board.
alternativeApproaches: Add time-travel history and discard future moves when a player branches from an older board.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Eight winning lines; draw; occupied square.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
